description: Canonical truth ownership for all important operational facts. One source per domain. If two files claim the same fact, this file wins.

repo_topology.description: Monorepo layout, subdirectory purposes, worktree root, K3s cluster IPs

sprint_state.description: Active sprint number, tasks, status, blockers. Changes every 1-2 weeks.

merge_policy.description: Required CI checks, merge strategy, readiness definition, admin bypass rules

agent_registry.description: All available agents, their paths, and routing triggers

skill_registry.description: All available skills, their canonical paths, and ownership

adr_decisions.description: Architecture Decision Records. Canonical under docs/adr/. Naming: ADR-NNNN-kebab-case-title.md. Never delete; use status: superseded.

cluster_topology.description: K3s node IPs, service ports. Source: repo-map.json .infrastructure.k3s

invariants.description: The 5 non-negotiable protocol invariants. Never override.

ci_exceptions.description: Documented CI exemptions with rationale and expiry

live_branch_state.description: Current branch, dirty files, uncommitted changes. NEVER hardcode.

live_pr_state.description: Open PRs and their CI state. NEVER hardcode.

forbidden: Do NOT hardcode sprint numbers in skills or agents — read ops/state/sprint/current.json
Do NOT hardcode PR numbers or branch lists — query via gh
Do NOT hardcode cluster IPs — read from repo-map.json#infrastructure
Do NOT use icn-ops/state paths — canonical is ops/state/ (inside monorepo)
Do NOT use icn-website/ paths — canonical is website/ (inside monorepo)
Do NOT reference sync-from-icn.sh — the website reads docs directly
